page: Amazon Web Services c8ib.2xlarge is an eighth-generation compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. The instance runs on an Intel x86_64 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. It provides 4 physical cores configured with 2 threads per core, yielding 8 dedicated vCPUs. System memory is provisioned at 16.0 GB, establishing a lean compute-optimized ratio of 2.0 GB of memory per vCPU.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 8 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for any persistent disk requirements. There are no discrete graphics processors bundled with this instance type, focusing its resource profile on pure CPU computation.

Because physical compute resources are dedicated and memory density is kept at a 1:2 ratio relative to vCPU count, the instance maximizes CPU resource density without allocating overhead to idle memory arrays or local disk capacity. The configuration fits compute-bound applications, including continuous integration and deployment pipelines, batch processing jobs, web application serving, and distributed compute worker tasks.
